entities.summary: Hermann Niehoff was a German general during World War II. In 1944, he was a lieutenant general and commander of Heeresgebiet Sudfrankreich facing the US/French invasion of southern France. From 2 March 1945, he was the garrison commander of Fortress Breslau during the Battle of Breslau, which he surrendered to the Soviet 6th Army on 6 May 1945.
